What is new

A download is installed only if it matches the checksum of the release and is signed with the same key as this app. For the first update, Android asks you to allow InterCom to install apps and may ask you to confirm; on Android 12 or newer, later updates install without a question. InterCom closes while it is replaced, and a notification tells you when it is done.
